description: Responsive pictures: a `Picture` component on astro:assets, a typed registry with credits and a /credits page, and a `Placeholder` for missing media.

boundaries: Every image goes through `src/data/pictures.ts` with its credit, and is shown with `<Picture>`. Never hotlink an image or use one without a license that allows it.

manual: Replace `src/assets/pictures/sample.jpg` with real pictures and record each credit in `src/data/pictures.ts`.
